The main takeaway from our work is that

the development of broad-based neuropsychological test batteries that are sensitive to the specific neurocognitive profile of persons with DS and that can be used to assess the efficacy of pharmacological interventions is essential.

the development of novel pharmacological interventions for individuals with intellectual disability should be based on a careful assessment of the cognitive phenotype of these individuals, and on the development of customized cognitive batteries to quantify specific cognitive abilities.
a battery of neuropsychological tests that is designed for use with typically developing individuals should be modified to accommodate the unique neurocognitive profile of individuals with DS.
